response.justification: The candidate lacks any demonstrable experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware optimization, or deep-learning workload analysis — core requirements for the Principal Performance Architect role. Their background is exclusively in full-stack web, mobile, and embedded software development with no evidence of hardware-software co-design, GPU architecture, or performance modeling for AI accelerators.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven track record in open-source contributions and developer tooling
Demonstrated ability to lead and teach through workshops and community projects
concerns: No experience with SoC, IP, or AI accelerator hardware modeling
Lacks background in deep-learning workload performance analysis or GPU architecture
No evidence of hardware-software co-design or system-level optimization for AI infrastructure
